intent: Facts an agent has stored: search, add, pin, edit or forget them (confirmed in an AlertDialog), and see which ones this thread used.
useWhen: show and manage an agent's long-term memory
let people correct or remove what the agent remembers
show which memories informed the current thread
doNotUseWhen: a generic list of records — ListView

items.note: { id, content, source?, age?, pinned?, usedHere? }[]. Pinned items group first.

onAdd.note: (content) => void. Add opens a form at the top.

onEdit.note: (id, content) => void. Edit expands the row in place.

onDelete.note: (id) => void. Called after the AlertDialog (Keep / Forget).

requirements: row actions are named icon Buttons; pin is a toggle with aria-pressed
actions show on hover and on keyboard focus
forget confirms in a kit AlertDialog
edit and add forms: Enter saves, Escape cancels
the privacy note is always visible

doNot: Do not invent a local MemoryList or FactsPanel
Do not delete a memory without the AlertDialog
Do not hide the privacy note
snippet: <MemoryPanel items={memories} query={query} onQueryChange={setQuery} onAdd={add} onEdit={edit} onPin={pin} onDelete={forget} />
